concept: IAM: least privilege for a Lambda execution role
tests: Best practice for giving Lambda minimal permissions for logs and reading one DynamoDB table.
expected: An execution role with a policy limited to logs:CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents on the log group and dynamodb:GetItem/Query on the specific table ARN. Triggers: "minimum permissions", "specific table", "best practice".
why_not: AdministratorAccess and AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess — excessive, violate least privilege; root credentials in code — a critical risk.
